evidence.title: BlockFi lending enforcement settlement
evidence.finding: SEC found unregistered lending products and misleading statements about portfolio risk. BlockFi agreed to cease unregistered offers and sales and pursue registration, with $100 million combined federal/state penalties.

evidence.title: BlockFi claims sale and customer recovery
evidence.finding: Administrator announced a transaction enabling 100% distributions on allowed customer and unsecured claims, following November 2022 bankruptcy. Claim recovery is not continuous liquidity, foregone interest, or restoration of original cryptocurrency units.

claims.reason: Bankruptcy and delayed distributions contradict the reassurance that this platform works better through illiquidity. Regulation was also overstated: the SEC found unregistered offers and misleading risk statements. No claim of permanent total loss is made.
